name: Thai Textile Industry Public Company Limited
summary: Thai Textile Industry Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, imports, exports, sells, and distributes raw cotton fibers, cotton yarns, blended yarns, synthetic yarns, greige fabrics, dyed fabrics, and yarn dyed fabrics in Thailand and internationally. It also provides finished garments under the TTI brand name. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Samutprakarn, Thailand.
